title: Create Wolf Factory Automation
why: A GitHub App private key is returned exactly once, to the browser session that converts the manifest. No API, token or MCP available here can create an App or mint a key.

steps.action: Open the manifest form and submit it
steps.note: The form carries the full, already-minimal manifest: contents:read, metadata:read, checks:write, actions:write. No webhook.

steps.action: Install the App on both accounts, selecting only these repositories
steps.note: Repository selection must be "Only select repositories". Do not grant "All repositories".

steps.action: Copy the three installation IDs, one per account/repository pairing
steps.note: Each installation ID is visible in the installation URL: /settings/installations/<id>.

steps.action: Store these repository secrets, never in a file
steps.note: Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions > New repository secret.

steps.action: Tell the agent the App is installed
steps.note: The next run mints App tokens automatically and reports authentication.mode = github-app. The PAT fallback stays until that run is green.
